basics.description: Deploy the Sentinel Flow Processor Function App, which serves cached Illumio inventory from a Sentinel data lake snapshot.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Region where all resources will be deployed.

elements.name: functionAppName
elements.label: Function App Name
elements.toolTip: Globally unique name for the Azure Function App (2-60 characters, letters, numbers, hyphens).

validations.message: Must be 2-60 characters: letters, numbers, and hyphens. Cannot start or end with a hyphen.

elements.name: storageAccountName
elements.label: Storage Account Name
elements.toolTip: Globally unique name for the Storage Account used by the Function App (3-24 lowercase letters and numbers only).

validations.message: Must be 3-24 characters: lowercase letters and numbers only.

elements.name: uniqueResourcesTableName
elements.label: Unique Resources Table Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Sentinel table that holds unique cloud resource records (e.g. UniqueResources_v1_SPRK).

validations.message: Must be 1-100 characters: letters, numbers, and underscores.

elements.name: enablePrivateNetworking
elements.label: Enable Private Networking
elements.toolTip: Disable public internet access to the Storage Account. Requires VNet integration to be configured after deployment.

elements.name: queryEndpoint
elements.label: KQL Query Endpoint
elements.toolTip: REST API URL for your Sentinel Log Analytics workspace, e.g. https://<workspace-id>.ods.opinsights.azure.com/v1/query

validations.message: Must be a valid HTTPS URL.

elements.name: sentinelWorkspace
elements.label: Sentinel Workspace Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace.

validations.message: Must be 1-100 characters: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores.

elements.name: sentinelDatabase
elements.label: Sentinel Database Name
elements.toolTip: KQL database name for queries against the Sentinel workspace.

validations.message: Must be 1-100 characters: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores.

elements.name: oauthScope
elements.label: OAuth Scope
elements.toolTip: OAuth 2.0 scope for the KQL REST API. Leave default unless using a custom AAD app.
